notes: Event date: 16 December 1944 (Ardennes p194: the heavy barrage opened on the 28th Division front on 16 December; p187: at 2100 General Cota turned the reserve battalion back to the 110th Infantry, minus Company G which was moved to Wiltz to defend the division command post; p205 calls Wiltz "the 28th Division command post"). Event definition: the 28th Division holds a 25-mile front on the Our and Clerf Rivers at the opening of the Ardennes offensive and loses its positions in the first days; the row dates the start of the attack on it. Relationship: VIII Corps and First Army (CMH table). Location: Wiltz town centroid; the atlas lists the division at Wiltz from 19 November. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Wiltz. Event support: high (dated in the Green Book). Location support: high (division command post stated for the date).
